name: promptfoo-llm-testing
description: Production-style LLM evaluation, prompt regression, model comparison, quality gates, and red teaming with Promptfoo and Azure OpenAI.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-project.mjs && promptfoo validate config -c promptfooconfig.yaml configs/basic-evaluation.yaml configs/prompt-regression.yaml configs/model-comparison.yaml configs/parameter-comparison.yaml configs/rag-evaluation.yaml configs/structured-output.yaml configs/security-regression.yaml configs/redteam.yaml
scripts.test:regression: promptfoo eval -c configs/prompt-regression.yaml --no-cache -o reports/regression-results.json -o reports/regression-results.csv -o reports/regression-report.html
scripts.test:redteam: npm run redteam:generate && npm run redteam:eval
scripts.redteam:eval: promptfoo redteam eval -c reports/generated-redteam.yaml -o reports/redteam-results.json -o reports/redteam-report.html
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:unit && npm run test:basic && npm run test:regression && npm run test:models && npm run test:parameters && npm run test:rag && npm run test:structured && npm run test:security-regression
